articles.summary: Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – November 5, 2026) – OBSIDIAN ENERGY LTD. (TSX: OBE) (NYSE American: OBE) (“Obsidian Energy“, the “Company“, “we“, “us” or “our“) is pleased to report our operating and financial results for the third quarter of 2026 (all amounts are in Canadian dollars unless otherwise noted). Obsidian Energy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results Highlights: Average production of 28,113 boe/d in the third quarter, generated strong funds flow from operations of $86.7 million with adjusted funds flow from operations of $80.7 million, excluding a $6.0 million share-based compensation recovery Recent Belly River acquisition outperforming expectations with current production of…
articles.title: Obsidian Energy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
